name: cs-navigator
description: CS Navigator is an evergreen capability curator with relevance-gated curation, live read-only capability discovery, and learning/academic capability guidance when useful.

interface.longDescription: CS Navigator is a small, stable curator layer for ChatGPT. It keeps ordinary tasks native, can offer a specialized capability path when that materially improves the result, and uses a read-only live capability registry for current discovery and evidence metadata. The 0.17 line adds Learning Mastery and international academic-writing capabilities while keeping them registry-only by default.
defaultPrompt: Use CS Navigator as my curator in this conversation.
Find the simplest useful capability path for this.
Check current capability evidence before recommending a workflow.
